traffic_protocol_evidence.description: 30 fixed route-template XMLs; each template has all three background routes active with 200, 150, and 240 vehicles (590 total), background lane 0. traffic_protocol_evidence.source_detail: The three routes are -E3→-E0, E0→E3, and E2→E1. The record states 30 templates and 200/150/240 route counts.

integrity_and_limitations.final_checkpoint_hash_matches_evaluation: All 20 local sorted result directories checked here (2 fresh 100k, 9 fresh 50k at depart_scale=4, 2 additional SAC density sweeps, and 7 continuation evaluations) matched evaluation identity SHA-256 to that directory's final_model.zip.
integrity_and_limitations.same_seed: Fresh 50k arguments identify training seed 0. The two local fresh 100k runs identify seed 0. Continuation uses the seed-0 base run, but continuation metadata does not independently prove restoration of RNG state.
integrity_and_limitations.evaluation_records: Every row has an evaluation summary with N=100. Several 50k D1 JSONs omit episode_records; the 10000–10099 evaluation seed range for those runs is supported by runner configuration/history rather than 100 retained per-episode records.
integrity_and_limitations.continuation_not_fresh: The c100000 directories mean 50k base plus 50k extra, not a fresh continuous 100k run. Replay buffer was not restored; learning warmup changed from 5000 to 500 raw steps. Do not compare these as the same budget trajectory as fresh 100k.
integrity_and_limitations.traffic_pool: The evaluation reuses 30 route variants with repeated episodes; 100 episodes are not 100 independent traffic templates. Historical factory code returned the full scaled route pool despite the MST argument label frozen_80_20; no held-out-template generalization claim is supported.

full_method_status.status: No formal evaluated full-method result found for this corrected sorted three-flow cohort.
full_method_status.clarification: MST+SLT is the user-designated strong baseline, not the full method. D1-Full artifacts are from older yield_v2 records and lack an eligible final evaluation for this cohort.

version_and_exclusion_basis.three_flow_evidence: The checked-in intersection_sorted/.depart_sorted marker and analysis/intersection_scenario_catalog_20261001.json identify the correction: traffic XMLs sorted by (depart, departLane) activate all three flows. analysis/scenario_medium_calibration_20260930.md independently describes 30 templates with all three routes and per-template counts 200/150/240.
version_and_exclusion_basis.one_flow_predecessor_exclusion: The erroneous predecessor is the separately named scene intersection / early yield_v2, not a result from corrected intersection_sorted. The scenario catalog cites the archived trainer note that departures in the unsorted source caused later flows to be ignored and that traffic_00 had only E2→E1 active entries. Exclude those predecessor results from the three-flow table.
version_and_exclusion_basis.one_flow_error: No result directory labeled intersection_sorted was found whose manifest or traffic asset contradicts the .depart_sorted three-flow marker. Do not label corrected sorted results as one-flow.
version_and_exclusion_basis.different_legacy_scenario: fast-developer/mst_slt__intersection_fixed/evaluation_results.json identifies scenario=intersection, not intersection_sorted; keep it outside the corrected sorted tables.
version_and_exclusion_basis.non-result_folders: The _p4_lowdensity_* directories did not contain evaluation_results.json in this scan and are not listed as formal outcome results.
